page.overview:
Who is Krall?

Lord Krall was an individual whose existence predated the third Galactic War.

Lord Krall was mentioned in the Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught expansion within the description of the general Tactical item "Krall's Accord", which is awarded to players at the end of the Onslaught storyline.
